verdict.rationale: Runway Dev offers a Playground for testing requests and runnable code and cURL examples in its API guide. It also publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec, which a probe confirmed is live at /openapi.json. Nothing in the evidence describes the API reference itself as interactive, with in-page try-it or runnable request panels; the runnable parts are a separate Playground and copy-paste examples. missing for 10: an evidenced interactive API reference with in-browser try-it execution, detail on what the Playground covers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
